'''Voloren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the time of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In the course of his service, he was pursued by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Malavai Quinn]]. When he was about to arrest Voloren, he was ordered by his supervisor, Moff [[Broysc]], to [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. Since the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] ignored Quinn's information, the Republic agent escaped.<ref name="Missed Opportunity">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Malavai Quinn|Missed Opportunity}}</ref> [[3643 BBY|Ten years later]], however, Malavai managed to find Voloren again and had him brought into Imperial custody.<ref name="Remedy the Past">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Malavai Quinn|Remedy the Past}}</ref>
